title: Windows Staging Git native stderr transport handling

phases.objective: Prevent Windows PowerShell from treating successful native Git stderr diagnostics as terminating errors while preserving exact exit-code failure handling and bounded retries.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Bootstrap accepts a successful Git fetch that emits progress/protocol text on stderr, continues to exact checkout and preflight, and still fails closed for a non-zero Git exit code or exhausted retryable transport failure.
steps: Invoke the shared Staging Git transport from Bootstrap under Windows PowerShell 5.1 ErrorActionPreference=Stop.
Capture Git stdout and stderr without allowing a successful stderr diagnostic to terminate the invocation.
Read an explicit exit marker emitted immediately after Git and accept the operation only when the marker is zero.
Continue the existing exact SHA checkout and schema/governance preflight only after the transport operation succeeds.
Preserve the existing retry and fail-closed behavior for non-zero retryable or non-retryable Git failures.
assertions: The transport sets Continue only inside the native Git capture scope and does not weaken the global fail-closed policy.
The transport records an explicit exit marker and branches on the captured exit code rather than on stderr presence.
A non-zero exit code remains STAGING_GIT_OPERATION_FAILED and retryable transport errors remain bounded by the existing attempt limit.
The fix does not read or print GitHub tokens, credentials, or local environment secrets.
The fix performs no Docker, MariaDB, schema apply, data import/export, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare, or Production operation.
No immutable schema.sql or published historical migration is changed.

phases.objective: This change grants no Production deployment, provider mutation, credential access, or production_live authority.
blockers: Production and provider actions require separate explicit authorization and independent evidence.
This transport fix only handles local Git process output and never activates production_live authority.
